messages:
Marta (CS): FYI — OrionBridge sent a custom onboarding request: low-latency 7B summarizer + reranker for shipping claims. Needs private deployment (VPC/on-prem), KMS-backed keys, full audit logs. Pilot target: 3 weeks. Renewal flagged if pilot slips.
Priya (Solutions Eng): @Devon can we support quantized int8 7B in Private? avg doc ~3k tokens, mostly text + small receipt images.
Devon (ML Eng): Int8 is fine on Dedicated/private. Latency depends on seq len + batching. For ~3k tokens we should do chunked summarization + streaming. If images included, that's a separate multimodal step.
Marta (CS): Customer says PDFs + occasional photos. Should we scope text-first, add images later?
Marcus (SE): Strongly recommend 2-phase: text-only first for evals and safety, then add OCR/image stage.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Need clarity on eval dataset — OrionBridge mentioned 500 labeled claims with golden summaries + priority labels. Will they provide via S3 or upload? Also what PII redaction level is required?
OrionBridge (customer): We can provide an S3 bucket with temp creds. We'll redact SSNs, but names/addresses remain. Retention <=30 days, require audit logs and canary on Dedicated. Budget for pilot is tight.
Sherri (CS lead): Noted on renewal risk and budget constraint. @billing FYI — this could escalate to churn if pilot blocked. Let's lock an enablement workshop next Tue.
Devon (ML Eng): Proposed safety/eval suite: Rouge + factuality checks + entity-level recall + hallucination detection. Need ~50 adversarial cases from them.
Marcus (SE): I'll draft a canary runbook: deploy to 2 private nodes, 5% traffic, monitor latency, regressions, and quality metrics. Add automatic fallback to hosted small-model for availability.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Who owns the S3 creds & transfer? CS shouldn't hold long-term creds. @SecurityBot what do we do?
SecurityBot: Reminder — use presigned S3 URLs or short-lived STS tokens for external bucket access. Do not store permanent keys in Slack or ticket comments.
Marta (CS): Owners: Marcus -> rollout runbook, Devon -> eval harness + tests, Priya -> infra & creds, Sherri -> enablement cadence & renewal tracking. I'll send calendar invites.
OrionBridge (customer): We'll prep S3 + 500 labeled samples by next Friday. Also can you confirm expected latency SLO for a 3k-token doc?
Devon (ML Eng): With chunked streaming: P95 per chunk ~400–700ms; end-to-end full doc ~1.2–2s depending on number of chunks and reranker passes. We'll include concrete numbers in proposal.
Marta (CS): Great — next steps: confirm S3 access method, share runbook draft, schedule enablement. Converting this into a support ticket now. :rocket:
